'''Nacrotis''' was a [[Poet/Legends|poet]], known for being eccentric and indifferent to the suffering of others. He was favored by an influential [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. Nacrotis would ingratiate himself into a person's life, gaining their trust before using his power and influence to destroy them. All the while, he would document their pain and suffering for his art.<ref name="TRG" />
